text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Um... next month is Brian-senpai's 
birthday, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Was that so? I can't be bothered to 
remember every little thing."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(Ooooh, so badass! Brian-senpai is just so 
damn cool...!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
! You knew... Ah, no. T-To tell you the 
truth, I totally forgot until just now. Oh 
man, I guess today really is my birthday.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Heard some folks making a fuss about it. 
......Congratulations."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, I'm not some kid who gets all 
hyped up just 'cause it's my birthday, 
okay?! I mean, I practically forgot about 
it anyway!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(Woohoo~!! *The* Brian-senpai\nwished me a 
happy birthday~!!\nI'll never forget this 
day...!)
